paper_metadata.title: Role of CeO2 coating in enhancing high temperature corrosion resistance of Ni-base superalloys as an inhibitor

evidence.quote: high temperature corrosion studies were conducted on two Ni-base superalloys, namely Superni 718 and Superni 601
